messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout v6.0.3 -> 5% eu-west, 5% us-west (change window 21:30-22:30 UTC)
clare: early telemetry: small p95 uplift in eu-west (~90ms) but sample size tiny
raj: pulling traces, seeing a handful of requests with truncated prompt tokens around segmentation boundary
sre-oncall: recommend a regional quiet-hold for eu-west while we triage. rather than full pin, can we route eu-west to compat-variant (v6.0.2-compat) as a soft rollback?
terry: +1 to compat route if it's fast to flip. avoids full unroll and keeps config simpler for dependent infra
clare: agree, compat route preserves new features where safe. can we do `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --variant compat-6.0.2`?
deploy-bot: suggested commands: `redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0` (stop percent) or `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --variant compat-6.0.2` (soft route)
release-eng: time to decision: soft-route is lower blast radius; pinning has operational overhead. prefer soft-route + smoke verification
sre-oncall: plan: soft-route eu-west -> compat-6.0.2, run smoke suite (tokenizer + kv + tail latency) for 10m, if green keep soft-route and continue global rollout; if failing, drop eu-west to 0% and pin to v6.0.2 and prepare rollback doc
clare: ready to execute soft-route when we have buy-in. change window still open ~48m
raj: capturing repro in INF-9900, adding trace ids and minimal curl. assigning to tokenizer-owner for root cause
deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --variant compat-6.0.2`
deploy-bot: eu-west route set to compat-6.0.2 (op: rx-4601) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: starting eu-west smoke now (quick inference x100, kv warmup checks) ETA ~6m
docs: drafting a concise release-note addendum: "EU percent paused to route to compat variant while we verify tokenizer changes". keeping language non-alarming
clare: smoke results: basic passes, tail latency restored to baseline, tokenization mismatch not observed under compat route
raj: tokenizer-owner reports a boundary-case with new tokenizer that only triggers on certain punctuation+emoji sequences; fix PR will land in ~3 hours
release-eng: decision: keep eu-west on compat route and let us-west continue percent rollout to 10% under observation. schedule v6.0.4 patch with tokenizer fix for next deploy window
sre-oncall: marking eu-west stop/go: SOFT-STOP (soft route active). us-west status: OBSERVE at 10%
terry: operational note: compat routes are sticky until unroute command; to resume original variant run `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --variant v6.0.3` after signoff
deploy-bot: reminder: to fully pin use `redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v6.0.2` or to remove route use `redwoodctl route remove --region eu-west --route-id rx-4601`
docs: will publish a short internal blurb for support and add a one-line note to public release notes if patch ETA slips beyond 3 hours
clare: will follow up in INF-9900 with repro details and will post here when PR merges and infra smoke is green
sre-oncall: thanks team. keeping watch on global SLOs and will escalate if any spillover occurs
